# Proverbs 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-man-of reproofs [who]-stiffens [his]-neck — suddenly will-be-broken and-without remedy.

**2** When-[the]-righteous increase the-people rejoice, but-when-[the]-wicked rules the-people groan.

**3** A-man loving wisdom gladdens his-father, but-a-companion-of prostitutes wastes wealth.

**4** A-king by-justice establishes a-land, but-a-man-of contributions tears-it-down.

**5** A-man flattering his-neighbor — a-net he-is-spreading upon his-steps.

**6** In-[the]-transgression-of a-man evil [is] a-snare, but-[the]-righteous sings and-rejoices.

**7** [The]-righteous knows [the]-cause-of [the]-poor; [the]-wicked does-not-understand knowledge.

**8** Men-of scoffing fan a-city, but-[the]-wise turn-away anger.

**9** A-man wise contending with-a-man foolish — whether-he-rages or-laughs there-is-no rest.

**10** Men-of blood hate [the]-blameless, but-[the]-upright seek his-soul.

**11** All his-spirit a-fool sends-forth, but-[the]-wise in-the-end quiets-it.

**12** A-ruler paying-attention to-a-word-of falsehood — all his-servants [become] wicked.

**13** [The]-poor and-[the]-man-of oppressions meet-together; [the]-one-giving-light-to [the]-eyes-of both-of-them [is] YHWH.

**14** A-king judging in-faithfulness [the]-poor — his-throne forever will-be-established.

**15** A-rod and-rebuke give wisdom, but-a-youth sent-away shames his-mother.

**16** When-[the]-wicked increase transgression increases, but-[the]-righteous will-look on-their-fall.

**17** Discipline your-son and-he-will-give-you-rest, and-he-will-give delights to-your-soul.

**18** Where-there-is-no vision the-people cast-off-restraint, but-one-keeping [the]-law — blessed [is]-he.

**19** By-words a-servant will-not-be-corrected, for he-understands but-there-is-no response.

**20** You-see a-man hasty in-his-words — more hope for-a-fool than-for-him.

**21** One-pampering from-youth his-servant — in-his-end he-will-be a-son.

**22** A-man-of anger stirs-up strife, and-a-master-of wrath [has]-many transgressions.

**23** [The]-pride-of a-man will-bring-him-low, but-[the]-humble-of spirit will-attain honor.

**24** One-sharing with-a-thief hates his-[own]-soul; an-oath he-hears but-does-not-tell.

**25** [The]-trembling-of a-man sets a-snare, but-one-trusting in-YHWH will-be-set-on-high.

**26** Many seek [the]-face-of a-ruler, but-from-YHWH [is the]-judgment-of a-man.

**27** [An]-abomination-of [the]-righteous [is] a-man-of injustice, and-[an]-abomination-of [the]-wicked [is one]-straight-of way.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **29:18**: Be-ein chazon yippara am — 'where there is no vision the people cast off restraint.' Chazon = prophetic vision/revelation, not merely human planning.

- **29:25**: Cherdat adam yitten moqesh — 'trembling/fear of man sets a snare.' The fear of human judgment as a trap. Antidote: trust in YHWH.

- **29:2**: Repeated theme of political wisdom — the character of rulers directly affects the welfare of the governed.

— EMET
